anomalies.observed: The page 1 assembly note says “Short R10, R10 for Core2 and CoreS3.” R10 selects PWM1_C2 to PWM1, while R12 is the jumper that selects PWM2_C2 to PWM2. Following the note literally therefore leaves the PWM2 selection unspecified and can leave PWM2 disconnected for those variants.
anomalies.expected: The Core2/CoreS3 instruction should identify one jumper for each channel: R10 for PWM1_C2 and R12 for PWM2_C2.

evidence.quote: Page 1, upper right: “Short R10, R10 for Core2 and CoreS3”; R12 is drawn between PWM2_C2 and PWM2.
§2: “R9–R12 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2.”

anomalies.impact: If assembled by following the note literally, PWM2 may not be connected to the intended Core2/CoreS3 bus GPIO, so the second PWM servo channel may not operate.

parsed.summary: The Core2/CoreS3 jumper instruction repeats R10, although R12 is the corresponding selection jumper for PWM2. This creates an assembly ambiguity that can leave the second PWM channel unconnected.
